name: ProGroCo Live Rosin Disposable | Mega Cake
description:
Lineage: Don Mega x Wedding Cake

Type: Indica-leaning Hybrid

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, and Myrcene

Aroma: Creamy cake notes balanced by subtle earthy undertones

Effect: Deeply relaxing and can help manage stress and anxiety

Mega Cake strain is an indica-dominant hybrid known for its euphoric, calming, and mood-enhancing effects, featuring a rich dessert-like flavor profile.
